title: Qualifications: choose the structure (round 2)
question: Compact and purposeful: the chart and the table become one setters list, and the goal leads. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Split desk
options.lineage: A mail client's two panes: who, then what they sent
options.thesis: The band carries the goal (29 of 70, one bar built from each setter's share). Below, one split card: setters on the left (count, a bar, per hour, last event, with 'All setters' first) and, on the right, the submissions of whoever is selected, with search and stage. Everything fits one screen, and each pane scrolls on its own.
options.viewport: Navy band: Qualified Leads, the range and Live line, Schedules, Export, picker; under a hairline, TEAM GOAL '29 of 70', '41%', a 14px bar in setter segments, '70 a day × 1 business day', Edit goal. Below, a split card: left, 360px Setters (All setters 29; Sarah Dacosta 12 with a bar and '1.7/h · 4:44 PM'; then the rest; '7 scheduled, none yet' in one line); right, 'Sarah Dacosta · 12 qualified' with a search, a stage select and ruled rows (QUALIFIED, LEAD, PROGRAM, STAGE) that open in place.
options.risk: The chart and table merge into a list, so the separate bar chart is gone. On a phone the panes stack, with the setters first.

options.label: Setter ledger that opens
options.lineage: A ledger whose rows open on their entries
options.thesis: The band carries the goal. One Setters ledger replaces the chart and the table: each row has the avatar, the name, a bar, the count, per hour and last event. Opening a row shows that setter's newest qualifications in place, with a link to all of them. All submissions, with search and stage, sit below.
options.viewport: The same navy band with the goal row. A full-width Setters card: 48px rows, with Sarah Dacosta open to show four qualifications (time, lead, program, stage word) and '4 of 12 · Show all 12 in Submissions'. Zero setters fold into one line. Footer: 'Total qualified 29'. The All submissions card starts below the first screen.
options.risk: Submissions move below the first screen, and the search for all leads is one scroll away.

options.label: Ring in the band, two columns
options.lineage: Your goal ring, shrunk into the header
options.thesis: The goal ring you have now shrinks to 64px inside the navy band, beside the condensed figures QUALIFIED 29 · TEAM GOAL 70 · TO GO 41. Under it, two cards side by side: Setters (each a row with a bar) and Submissions as compact two-line rows. Pressing a setter filters Submissions and shows a removable chip.
materials: navy band with a mini ring and figures
options.viewport: Navy band: title, range and Live line, actions, picker; then a 64px ring reading 41% beside QUALIFIED 29, TEAM GOAL 70, TO GO 41, with '70 a day × 1 business day · Edit goal' on the right. Below, left: Setters (bar under each name, '1.7/h · 4:44 PM', count at 20px); right: Submissions with a 'Sarah Dacosta ×' chip, search and stage, and rows of time, lead, handle · setter and stage word.
options.risk: The two columns halve the width, so long lead names and handles truncate. 'To go' is a new figure (goal minus qualified).
